items.headline: Cisco permitted for $15M second-floor office buildout
items.summary: A $15,000,000 office tenant improvement permit was issued for the second floor at 3098 Olsen Drive for Cisco, one of the larger commercial permits in this batch.

items.headline: Campbell to split $335,000 resurfacing cost with San Jose
items.summary: The city council approved a cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose, not to exceed $335,000, to fund resurfacing work.

items.headline: 5-unit townhouse project permitted on Seely Avenue
items.summary: A new 5-unit townhouse building (Trimble Summerhill, Lot 21) was permitted on Seely Avenue, valued at $1,841,161; the lot has no street number assigned yet.
